description: Seal change started. Locked out. Bowl drained. Replacing seal kits on valves 3, 9, 15 and 21 (SEAL-FV-24).
Old seals flattened and cracked at the edge. Seals had about 1,720 running hours - past the 1,500-hour limit.
New seals fitted. Tools and parts counted. Lock removed. Sanitation rinse 10 minutes done.
First-bottle check: first 6 bottles 506-509 ml in the first 2 minutes, then 499-502 ml.
action_taken: Operator worried about overfill. Technician explained slight overfill while new seals settle is expected (WI-FL101-001). Checkweigher rejected the 6 bottles. All later bottles in range.

description: First-bottle check signed off by shift supervisor. Production restarted at 120 bottles per minute.
Reject count back to 2 per 1,000. No dripping valves.
Seals replaced on 4 valves. Running well.
